name: list_projects
description:
List the projects of the authenticated user or the selected team. Results are paginated using limit and from. Optionally filter by name search, Git repository, connected Global Config, build settings, and other listed filters.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} project list. Fill placeholders from inputs.

buildMachineTypes.description: Filter results by effective build machine types. Accepts comma-separated values. Use \"elastic\" for projects with elastic selection and \"default\" for projects without a build machine type set.

buildQueueConfiguration.description: Filter results by build queue configuration. SKIP_NAMESPACE_QUEUE includes projects without a configuration set.

edgeConfigId.description: Filter results by connected Global Config ID

edgeConfigTokenId.description: Filter results by connected Global Config Token ID

elasticConcurrencyEnabled.description: Filter results by projects with elastic concurrency enabled

excludeRepos.description: Filter results by excluding those projects that belong to a repo

from.description: Query only projects updated after the given timestamp or continuation token.

gitForkProtection.description: Specifies whether PRs from Git forks should require a team member's authorization before it can be deployed

limit.description: Limit the number of projects returned

repo.description: Filter results by repo. Also used for project count

search.description: Search projects by the name field

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

staticIpsEnabled.description: Filter results by projects with Static IPs enabled

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
